gameDescriptionHtml:
Slyders is a FPS survival roguelite bullet hell that blends fast-paced shooter action with an over-the-top upgrade system. You’re Aryx, a fearless fox freedom fighter on his supersonic battle turtle who aims to liberate Sky World from evil.

If you want fight to an evil massive army alone, you must become an unstoppable force of destruction! Choose from a wide range of active and passive abilities, summon powerful allies like Bernard, the elephant warrior, or Sandy, the giant sandworm lady. Deploy deadly turrets, collect special weapons, loot and upgrade powerful items, face mighty bosses, and dodge the onslaught of incoming rockets!

Sky World is an endless heaven full of inhabited floating islands, each with its own people and culture. But now, an evil overlord with his demon army has attacked the once peaceful realm and is spreading chaos and corruption. Fortunately, a group of brave resistance fighters from all over Sky World has combined their forces to liberate each island from the evil influence.

You play as Aryx, a fearless fox fighter who is accompanied by his supersonic turtle mount and Brian, a tiny but wise bear with a jetpack. Together, the heroic trio steps up to face the entire demonic war machine.

Game Features

  • Rise from rookie to god of destruction in intense 15 minute runs.
  • Fast-paced combat and movement.
  • Upgrade an arsenal of active, passive and stat abilities.
  • Meta progression with mighty Powerups and Weapons.
  • Loot powerful Items from Bosses.
  • Unlock multiple maps and explore the diverse regions of Sky World.
